facts.fact: The watch-house has laterite walls, a slate roof and a doorless frame; Kuttu lit the gate basket at dawn and Janu swept the floor.

Captain Haran carries the green case; before the Nellimala clause he steps forward and asks the queen, before the Company, to strike it. The queen refuses aloud and loses his regard, and Neela chooses to stay silent and let the queen carry the choice.
The queen never noticed the intake rolls looped to the crown leaves until Neela stopped the burning.
Devan's hand at the back of Neela's neck, the old 'wait' place, no longer makes her stiffen.
Devan has counted Neela's breath hitch every morning since the wedding; hers is at the ninth count, his at a third of the way.

At first grey Kuttu sounds the horn from the watch-house and calls a lone climber on the pass road with no riders behind; Devan calls it the Company's first vote under the charter, with the right to refuse.
